desc:
EVIL SANTA caught you being NAUGHTY! 😈 He took you all the way to the NORTH POLE and locked you in his toy factory. Can you escape the North Pole and make it home before Christmas? 🎄

🎅 Run from Evil Santa, the Nutcracker and the evil snowman
🏭 Dodge traps in the toy factory, the stable and the frozen lake
⚔️ Beat Santa in an EPIC boss fight
🛷 Fly his magic sleigh and deliver the presents
🍫 Collect chocolate coins and buy cool items in the shop
😂 Morphs and trolls to prank your friends
👫 Play solo or with friends

Can you escape this Christmas obby? 🏃

👍 LIKE + ⭐ FAVORITE if you had fun!
🔔 Join Boing Studios for more games!
